content: devague export lint gotcha: `devague export` (spec + plan) writes claims/tasks as single unwrapped lines. markdownlint run from a repo root enforces MD013 (a home-dir global config disabling MD013 is NOT picked up — config resolution stops at CWD), and committed specs are 80-col wrapped by convention. Fix cheaply up front: short period-free --title at `devague new`, task summaries under ~70 chars (they become ### headings — headings cannot wrap, MD022), backtick URLs/angle-bracket tokens in claim text. After export: reflow non-heading lines to 80 cols, lint the WHOLE file (not tail -3). Fixing confirmed text later means hand-editing .devague/*.json state and re-exporting (no edit move).
